result.topic_en: Calculations with confocal quadric (ellipsoidal) coordinates: the family x^2/(a+λ)+y^2/(b+λ)+z^2/λ=1 written as f(λ)=0, derivatives of λ with respect to x, y, z, orthogonality of the coordinate surfaces, and expressions for the squared gradient of λ.
